US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average for state and local income taxes.

IN.description: Includes central income tax and health and education cess for a resident individual under the new tax regime.

SG.description: Progressive income tax only; no capital gains or inheritance tax. Includes marginal rates from 0% to 11.5% for this income level.

CH.description: Effective rate includes federal, cantonal, and communal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions, varying by canton and municipality.

NL.description: Includes national income tax (Box 1) and mandatory social security contributions.

GB.description: Includes income tax and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, Canada Pension Plan (CPP) contributions, and Employment Insurance (EI) premiums for an $85k USD earner in Ontario.

AE.description: No personal income tax is levied on individuals in the UAE.

NO.description: Includes state income tax, municipal income tax, and national insurance contributions.

IE.description: Effective rate includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions for pension, health, and long-term care for an $85k USD earner.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy, based on a $127,500 AUD equivalent income.

QA.description: No personal income tax or social security contributions for expatriates.

BN.description: Brunei has no personal income tax for individuals.

MO.description: Macao's territorial tax system with progressive rates and generous exemptions, resulting in a low effective rate for an $85k USD earner.
